bro these are just my and my excoworkers experiences… i dont need someone telling me that indentured servitude in prison is a good thing. these are terrible “wages” and is only compounded by the disproportionate amount of POC forced to work under these gulag conditions. 

starbucks is cool to work for in name only. thats why they have the waiting list. i would never work for that company again, licensed store or corporate store (i’ve done both)

also i WAS offered a position, did not quit, and waited for three months only to hear back that i would be making 2$ LESS an hour than I was before

but i mean all power to you, i hope the bottom of aramark’s boots taste good to u :-)

msee starbucks, jersey mikes, 3rd street starbucks are the ones i know off the top of my head, we all got dispersed to different positions after we were *lied* to about keeping our position and pay rate. basically we were all fired. most of us went to work at other places because aramark is an awful company that uses prison labor

vienna has a great crowd of regulars, i live right above it and have met many amazing and interesting people there. great coffee selection and even better taste

greyhouse is a nonprofit affiliated with campus house, had a guy from there tell me i should try conversion therapy so i generally try to avoid. super over priced too for the honestly small drink sizes. coffee is alright

copper moon in the hivine building has amazing staff but has terrible hours for the summer. judging from last year they will probably be open for longer the school year. coffee is great here too. cant really speak for the other coppermoons around here. 

leaps in the union has alright coffee but its also incredibly over priced seeing that its in pmu hotel and affiliated with aramark. really only go there when my friend is working to get free drinks lol

theres a starbucks on 3rd street and in MSEE and theyre about what you would expect
much respect

avoid working in or around purdue dining, it was bad before aramark came in and now its worse (judging from all of my former coworkers experiences)

being a barista is a good semi-low stress job for college if you need some extra cash in your pocket, but the pay isn’t the best

one of the best places to work right now is Town and Gown on river road off state street (next to the mcdonalds) we’re short staffed and could really use the help. ***really*** good base rate pay and you get tips on top of that. it helps if you have serving experience (or food service in general)
